definitions.ratio_to_null: mean over the range's blocks of (s_fc1 + s_fc2) / 2, divided by the mean over the same blocks of the null means of (s_fc1 + s_fc2) / 2 (PREREG_NEXT_PHASE.md Section 1)
definitions.twin_fraction_t50: mean over blocks of the share of hidden units in a 2-cycle of the matched permutation whose twin correlation is at least 0.5
definitions.share_4cycles: R90: mean over blocks of the share of hidden units in 4-cycles of the Hungarian matching after other cycle lengths are turned into fixed points
definitions.twin_null: same pipeline with the token alignment replaced by a random patch permutation with the action's cycle type; mean and 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles over draws of the range mean
definitions.null interval of a range: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles over draws of the range mean
